blocks.en: 1. Introduction and Scope

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼需要 USP ⟨797⟩？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Do We Need USP ⟨797⟩?

blocks.zh: Compounded Sterile Preparation, CSP (調配無菌製劑)：與工廠大量生產的藥品不同，CSP 是藥房或醫療機構根據病患個別需求現場調配的無菌藥劑。因為沒有經過完整的商業製造驗證流程，其污染風險本質上更高。
blocks.en: Compounded Sterile Preparation (CSP): Unlike factory-manufactured drug products, a CSP is a sterile medication prepared on site by a pharmacy or healthcare facility for an individual patient's needs. Because it has not gone through a full commercial manufacturing validation process, its contamination risk is inherently higher.

blocks.zh: 本章列出六大患者危害來源：(1) 微生物污染、(2) 過量細菌內毒素、(3) 含量偏差、(4) 物化不相容、(5) 化學/物理污染物、(6) 劣質原料。這六點直接對應到 FDA 歷年召回事件中的主要原因。
blocks.en: The chapter lists six sources of patient harm: (1) microbial contamination, (2) excessive bacterial endotoxins, (3) variability in the intended strength, (4) physical and chemical incompatibilities, (5) chemical and physical contaminants, and (6) ingredients of inappropriate quality. These six map directly to the main causes of FDA recalls over the years.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：調配藥局 vs 製藥工廠
blocks.en: Analogy: Compounding Pharmacy vs. Pharmaceutical Factory

blocks.zh: 想像一下：工廠製造的瓶裝礦泉水（conventionally manufactured product）有完整的滅菌驗證和品管體系；而 CSP 比較像是廚師在廚房現場製作的特調飲料——同樣需要衛生規範，但環境和驗證深度不同。
blocks.en: Imagine this: a bottle of mineral water made in a factory (a conventionally manufactured product) comes with full sterilization validation and a quality control system. A CSP is more like a specialty drink a chef makes on the spot in the kitchen: hygiene rules still apply, but the environment and the depth of validation are different.

blocks.zh: USP ⟨797⟩ 就是設定這個「廚房」的最低衛生標準，讓調配出的製劑足夠安全。
blocks.en: USP ⟨797⟩ sets the minimum hygiene standard for this "kitchen", so that what is compounded is safe enough.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Designated Person 的法律責任
blocks.en: Key Point: The Legal Accountability of the Designated Person

blocks.zh: Designated Person（指定人員）不只是一個頭銜，而是具有法律問責性的職位。在 FDA 的 483 觀察和警告信中，designated person 的缺失或失職是常見缺失項目。
blocks.en: The Designated Person is not just a title; it is a position with legal accountability. In FDA Form 483 observations and warning letters, a missing or negligent designated person is a common finding.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：必須在 SOP 中明確定義 designated person 的職責範圍，並有書面指派記錄。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: the responsibilities of the designated person must be clearly defined in an SOP, with a documented written appointment.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：哪些製劑必須無菌？
blocks.en: Practical Application: Which Preparations Must Be Sterile?

blocks.zh: 快速判斷規則——凡是進入「正常情況下不與外界溝通的體腔」或「直接進入血液循環」的，都必須無菌：
blocks.en: A quick rule of thumb: anything that enters a body cavity that normally does not communicate with the outside, or that goes directly into the bloodstream, must be sterile:

blocks.zh: 注射劑、輸液 → 無菌
blocks.en: Injections and infusions → sterile

blocks.zh: 眼科製劑 → 無菌
blocks.en: Ophthalmic preparations → sterile

blocks.zh: 肺部吸入水溶液 → 無菌
blocks.en: Aqueous inhalation solutions for the lungs → sterile

blocks.zh: 膀胱沖洗液 → 無菌（但口腔沖洗液不需要）
blocks.en: Bladder irrigation solutions → sterile (but mouth rinses do not need to be)

blocks.zh: 植入物 → 無菌
blocks.en: Implants → sterile

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一位藥師想要調配眼科滴眼液，但認為局部製劑不需要無菌。這個判斷正確嗎？請引用 1.1.1 條文說明。
blocks.en: A pharmacist wants to compound eye drops but believes topical preparations do not need to be sterile. Is this correct? Cite section 1.1.1 in your answer.

blocks.zh: 醫院藥局將靜脈輸液重新分裝到較小的注射瓶。這是否需要符合 ⟨797⟩？
blocks.en: A hospital pharmacy repackages an intravenous infusion into smaller injection vials. Does this need to comply with ⟨797⟩?

blocks.zh: 放射性藥物 (Radiopharmaceuticals) 是否需要符合 ⟨797⟩？依據為何？
blocks.en: Do radiopharmaceuticals need to comply with ⟨797⟩? What is the basis?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Administration | 給藥 & 1.3 Immediate-Use CSPs | 即時使用CSP
blocks.en: 1.2 Administration & 1.3 Immediate-Use CSPs

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Immediate-Use CSP 的豁免邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Exemption Logic of Immediate-Use CSPs

blocks.zh: Immediate-Use CSP (即時使用CSP)：當臨床急需而無法符合正規 Category 1/2/3 要求時，可在滿足7個嚴格條件下調配的製劑。
blocks.en: Immediate-Use CSP: A preparation that may be compounded when there is an urgent clinical need and the formal Category 1/2/3 requirements cannot be met, provided 7 strict conditions are satisfied.

blocks.zh: 豁免的核心原因是時間窗口極短（4小時內給藥），污染後增殖的風險遠低於有 BUD 的製劑。但請注意：這不是「隨便做」的許可證，仍需書面 SOP 和人員訓練。
blocks.en: The exemption exists because the time window is very short (administration within 4 hours), so the risk of microbial growth after contamination is far lower than for preparations with a BUD. Note, however, that this is not a license to do it casually: a written SOP and personnel training are still required.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數字：Immediate-Use 的硬性限制
blocks.en: Key Numbers: The Hard Limits for Immediate-Use

blocks.zh:
最多混合成分數量：≤ 3 種不同無菌產品
給藥開始時限：   製備後 ≤ 4 小時
單次劑量容器：   不得供多位病患使用
未使用殘餘物：   製備完成後立即丟棄
blocks.en:
Maximum number of components:   ≤ 3 different sterile products
Time to start of administration:   ≤ 4 hours after preparation
Single-dose containers:   must not be used for more than one patient
Unused remainder:   discard immediately after preparation is complete

blocks.zh: 重點提示：常見誤解 — 「按仿單稀釋」算不算調配？
blocks.en: Key Point: A Common Misunderstanding - Does "Diluting per the Labeling" Count as Compounding?

blocks.zh: 1.4 節明確排除了按核准仿單操作的重配行為，但有兩個先決條件：(1) 為單一病患配製；(2) 仿單已涵蓋稀釋劑、濃度、容器和儲存時間。
blocks.en: Section 1.4 explicitly excludes reconstitution performed according to the approved labeling, but with two prerequisites: (1) it is prepared for a single patient; (2) the labeling covers the diluent, concentration, container and storage time.

blocks.zh: 若仿單缺少上述任一項資訊，該操作就落入 ⟨797⟩ 範疇。實務上這常是稽查缺失的灰色地帶。
blocks.en: If the labeling lacks any of this information, the operation falls within the scope of ⟨797⟩. In practice, this is often a gray area in inspection findings.

blocks.zh: 比喻：袋瓶系統的兩種情境
blocks.en: Analogy: Two Scenarios for a Bag-and-Vial System

blocks.zh: 想像一個咖啡膠囊機：直接按鈕沖泡給客人喝（立即使用）= 不需特殊清潔室。但若事先把膠囊插入機器，留待稍後使用（future activation）= 就等同於提前調配，需要符合無菌環境要求。
blocks.en: Imagine a coffee capsule machine: pressing the button and serving the coffee right away (immediate use) = no special cleanroom needed. But if the capsule is inserted into the machine in advance and left for later use (future activation), that is equivalent to compounding ahead of time and must meet sterile environment requirements.

blocks.zh: Proprietary bag and vial system 的邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: The logic of a proprietary bag and vial system is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 急診護士從4支不同的單次劑量注射瓶中抽取藥物混合給藥。這是否符合 Immediate-Use 豁免條件？
blocks.en: An emergency nurse draws drugs from 4 different single-dose vials and mixes them for administration. Does this meet the Immediate-Use exemption conditions?

blocks.zh: 某藥師在早上8點調配了一袋靜脈輸液，預計下午1點開始輸注，但未存放於 ISO Class 5 環境。是否違規？
blocks.en: A pharmacist compounds an intravenous infusion bag at 8 a.m., with infusion expected to start at 1 p.m., and it was not stored in an ISO Class 5 environment. Is this a violation?

blocks.zh: 按照製造商仿單重配抗生素注射劑，仿單只提供了稀釋液和濃度，但未說明儲存時間。這是否需要符合 ⟨797⟩？
blocks.en: An antibiotic injection is reconstituted per the manufacturer's labeling, but the labeling gives only the diluent and concentration and does not state a storage time. Does this need to comply with ⟨797⟩?

blocks.zh: 1.5 CSP Categories | CSP 分類系統
blocks.en: 1.5 CSP Categories

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三分類系統的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Design Logic of the Three-Category System

blocks.zh: 分類決定因素：環境控制程度 × 儲存時間風險 × 微生物增殖概率。三個類別呈金字塔形：Category 1 門檻最低但 BUD 最短；Category 3 要求最多但可獲得最長使用期限。
blocks.en: Factors that determine the category: level of environmental control × risk from storage time × probability of microbial growth. The three categories form a pyramid: Category 1 has the lowest threshold but the shortest BUD; Category 3 has the most requirements but can obtain the longest beyond-use date.

blocks.zh: 這個設計反映一個核心理念：「你想存放越久，就必須付出更多品質控制的代價。」
blocks.en: This design reflects a core principle: "The longer you want to store it, the more you must pay in quality control."

blocks.zh: Category 3 — 最嚴格要求 / 最長 BUD
blocks.en: Category 3 - Strictest requirements / longest BUD

blocks.zh: Category 2 — 中等要求 / 中等 BUD
blocks.en: Category 2 - Intermediate requirements / intermediate BUD

blocks.zh: Category 1 — 基本要求 / 最短 BUD
blocks.en: Category 1 - Basic requirements / shortest BUD

blocks.zh: 重點提示：非無菌起始原料的內毒素風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Endotoxin Risk from Nonsterile Starting Components

blocks.zh: 使用非無菌起始原料時，即使通過過濾滅菌，細菌內毒素（革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁碎片）不會被 0.22 µm 濾膜去除。因此必須有額外的去熱原策略（如適當沖洗或選用通過 LAL 測試的原料）。
blocks.en: When nonsterile starting components are used, bacterial endotoxins (fragments of Gram-negative bacterial cell walls) are not removed by a 0.22 µm filter, even if the preparation is filter sterilized. An additional depyrogenation strategy is therefore required (such as appropriate rinsing, or selecting components that pass the LAL test).

blocks.zh: 這是 Category 2/3 CSP 從非無菌原料調配時最常見的合規陷阱。
blocks.en: This is the most common compliance trap when Category 2/3 CSPs are compounded from nonsterile components.

blocks.zh: 選擇 Category 的決策樹
blocks.en: Decision Tree for Choosing a Category

blocks.zh:
需要 BUD > 12 h (室溫) 或 > 24 h (冷藏)?
    否 → Category 1 (SCA 可接受)
    是 ↓
需要 BUD 超過 Table 13 限制?
    否 → Category 2 (需要 Cleanroom Suite)
    是 ↓
Category 3 (需要滅菌測試 + 穩定性數據)
blocks.en:
Need a BUD > 12 h (room temperature) or > 24 h (refrigerated)?
    No → Category 1 (SCA acceptable)
    Yes ↓
Need a BUD beyond the Table 13 limits?
    No → Category 2 (requires a cleanroom suite)
    Yes ↓
Category 3 (requires sterility testing + stability data)

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 合規場景
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Compliance Scenarios

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 接受醫院藥局的外包調配業務。在報價前必先確認：客戶需求的 BUD 屬於哪個 Category？ Category 3 CSP 的調配成本遠高於 Category 1（需要滅菌測試、穩定性研究、月頻環境監測），這直接影響定價策略。
blocks.en: Many CDMOs accept outsourced compounding work from hospital pharmacies. Before quoting, always confirm which Category the customer's required BUD falls into. The compounding cost of a Category 3 CSP is far higher than that of Category 1 (it requires sterility testing, stability studies and monthly environmental monitoring), which directly affects the pricing strategy.

blocks.zh: 醫院藥局要調配一批靜脈化療藥物，需要在冰箱存放 7 天。屬於哪個 Category？
blocks.en: A hospital pharmacy wants to compound a batch of intravenous chemotherapy drugs that must be stored in a refrigerator for 7 days. Which Category does this fall into?

blocks.zh: Category 3 CSP 比 Category 2 多了哪四項主要要求？
blocks.en: What are the four main additional requirements of a Category 3 CSP compared with Category 2?

blocks.zh: 若以非無菌原料調配 Category 2 CSP，除了過濾滅菌之外，還需要特別注意什麼？
blocks.en: If a Category 2 CSP is compounded from nonsterile components, what else needs special attention besides filter sterilization?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP ⟨797⟩ 設定 CSP 調配的最低標準，目的是防止六大患者危害（微生物污染、內毒素過量、含量偏差、物化不相容、化學污染物、劣質原料）
blocks.en: USP ⟨797⟩ sets the minimum standard for CSP compounding, aiming to prevent six types of patient harm (microbial contamination, excessive endotoxin, variability in strength, physical and chemical incompatibility, chemical contaminants, and poor-quality ingredients)

blocks.zh: CSP 分三類：Category 1（最短 BUD，最少要求）→ Category 2（中等）→ Category 3（最長 BUD，最多要求）
blocks.en: CSPs fall into three categories: Category 1 (shortest BUD, fewest requirements) → Category 2 (intermediate) → Category 3 (longest BUD, most requirements)

blocks.zh: Immediate-Use CSP 豁免需同時滿足7項條件，核心限制是：≤3種成分、≤4小時給藥
blocks.en: The Immediate-Use CSP exemption requires all 7 conditions to be met at the same time; the core limits are ≤ 3 components and administration within ≤ 4 hours

blocks.zh: Designated Person 對 CSP 品質具有法律問責性，必須書面指派
blocks.en: The Designated Person is legally accountable for CSP quality and must be appointed in writing

blocks.zh: 非無菌起始原料即使經過過濾滅菌，仍需處理細菌內毒素風險
blocks.en: Even after filter sterilization, nonsterile starting components still require the bacterial endotoxin risk to be addressed
